values.LAMMPS_PARTITION: Slurm partition MLIP molecular dynamics runs in
values.LAMMPS_CORES_PER_NODE: cores per node of that partition
values.LAMMPS_PARTIAL_NODE: true when a run may use fewer cores than the node has (launch_plan then accepts R x T below the node's cores and counts cost on the cores used)
values.LAMMPS_DEFAULT_LAYOUT: R x T launch_plan returns when no md_step timing is recorded, e.g. 1x56
values.LAMMPS_EXE: build_id -> the lmp binary of that software_registry build (several builds can share one env_script)
values.LAMMPS_LAUNCH: launch_plan's job-spec templates: {pre_launch, launcher, environment}, with {R} ranks/node, {T} threads/rank, {N} nodes, {env_script} and other values by name
